Examples: The equality impact assessment was written after the decision. | An equality impact assessment is a form or a question, depending who signs it.

Definition: cuộc điều tra hộ gia đình
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; conduct/a + household survey
Examples: The household survey asked nine thousand families the same question. | A household survey misses anyone without an address.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; carry out/a + needs assessment
Examples: The needs assessment took four months and two visits. | A needs assessment decides what help arrives.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a low/the + participation rate
Examples: The participation rate among the poorest fifth barely moved. | Participation rates rose once the bus was free.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; improve/lack + representation
Examples: Representation on the board changed which questions were asked. | They had numbers and no representation.

Definition: làm cho có, mang tính hình thức
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; accuse sb of + tokenism
Examples: One appointment without power is tokenism. | Tokenism satisfies the report and nobody else.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; show/express + solidarity
Examples: Solidarity between the two trades held through nine weeks. | They showed solidarity in the practical way: with money.

Pattern: advocate + N; advocate for + sb
Examples: She advocated for tenants without charging a fee. | They advocate a single simple payment.

Pattern: protest against + N; protest about + N
Examples: Residents protested against the closure for nine months. | They protested about the charge and it was withdrawn.

Pattern: volunteer; volunteer to + V
Examples: Nine neighbours volunteered on the first morning. | She volunteers at the advice centre every Thursday.

Pattern: contribute + N + to + N
Examples: A local firm contributed the whole kitchen. | They contribute the surplus to the food bank every week.

Pattern: fundraise; fundraise for + N
Examples: They fundraised for a minibus for two years. | The club fundraises through a single summer fair.

Pattern: assist + sb + with + N
Examples: Volunteers assist claimants with the online forms. | She was assisted by a neighbour who understood the system.

Definition: chỉ dẫn tới nơi hỗ trợ
Pattern: signpost + sb + to + N
Examples: The centre signposts people to legal advice. | They were signposted to three services and helped by none.

Pattern: prioritise + N; thường bị động
Examples: The worst housing was prioritised for inspection. | They prioritised the wards with the youngest population.

Pattern: ring-fence + N; thường bị động
Examples: The money was ring-fenced for the two poorest wards. | They ring-fenced the budget and spent it elsewhere.

Definition: xét theo điều kiện thu nhập
Pattern: means-test + N; thường bị động
Examples: The payment was means-tested from 2010. | Means-testing the allowance cost more than it saved.

Pattern: a low-income + N (household, area)
Examples: Low-income households spend a fifth of their money on energy. | Low-income areas have the fewest cash machines.

Definition: có xét điều kiện thu nhập
Pattern: a means-tested + N (benefit, grant)
Examples: A means-tested grant reaches fewer people than it should. | Means-tested support carries a stigma universal support does not.

Pattern: an at-risk + N (household, group)
Examples: At-risk households were moved twice in one winter. | The phrase at-risk does a lot of work in that policy.

Pattern: be eligible + for + N
Examples: Nine hundred households are eligible and four hundred claim. | She was eligible for help and never told.

Pattern: be ineligible + for + N
Examples: He was ineligible by a margin of nine pounds. | Ineligible applicants are told by letter and not why.

Pattern: be/leave sb + destitute
Examples: The refusal left the family destitute for three weeks. | Nobody should be destitute in a country with this much housing.

Pattern: a well-off + N (household, suburb)
Examples: The well-off suburbs have the best bus service. | Well-off households gained most from the tax change.

Pattern: be hard-up; a hard-up + N
Examples: Hard-up families use the launderette rather than buy a machine. | They were hard-up for nine years and never said so.

Pattern: an overlooked + N (group, town)
Examples: Overlooked towns appear in the data and not in the plans. | The night staff were the overlooked half of the service.

Pattern: the + voiceless; a voiceless + N
Examples: The scheme was designed for a voiceless group and without them. | Nobody is voiceless; some are simply not listened to.

Pattern: reach out to + sb; không tách được
Examples: The centre reached out to households nobody had contacted. | They reached out to nine families and heard from two.

Pattern: look out for + sb; không tách được
Examples: Neighbours look out for the older residents in cold weather. | They looked out for each other through the whole dispute.

Pattern: stick up for + sb; không tách được
Examples: One supervisor stuck up for the whole night shift. | She sticks up for anyone treated badly at the counter.

Pattern: take on board + N hoặc take + N + on board
Examples: The panel took the objections on board and changed nothing. | They took on board every comment from the residents.

Definition: bị bỏ sót (khỏi diện hỗ trợ)
Pattern: fall through the net
Examples: Nine households fell through the net entirely. | Anyone without an address falls through the net.

Pattern: get by; get by on + N
Examples: They get by on one wage and a lot of planning. | She got by for nine months without any help.

Definition: tạm bằng lòng với những gì có
Pattern: make do; make do with + N
Examples: They made do with one heated room. | Making do is a skill and not a virtue.

Pattern: scrape by; scrape by on + N
Examples: They scraped by until the boiler failed. | Nine households on that landing scrape by every winter.

Pattern: chip in; chip in for + N
Examples: Neighbours chipped in for the funeral. | Everyone chipped in and the minibus was bought.

Pattern: club together + to + V
Examples: They clubbed together to pay the fare. | Nine families clubbed together for a single freezer.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; set/raise + a wage floor
Examples: A statutory wage floor removed the worst of the undercutting. | Raising the wage floor lifted nine thousand households.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; impose/the + benefit cap
Examples: The benefit cap takes no account of local rents. | A benefit cap hits the largest families hardest.

Definition: dịch vụ đi lại do cộng đồng tổ chức
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; run + community transport
Examples: Community transport takes nine passengers to the clinic. | Community transport replaced the route the company dropped.

Pattern: danh từ số nhiều; campaign for + disability rights
Examples: Disability rights were won by protest, not by committee. | Disability rights law changed buildings more slowly than attitudes.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; challenge/reinforce + a gender stereotype
Examples: The advertisement reinforced every gender stereotype going. | Challenging gender stereotypes begins with the reading books.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; demand/receive + equal treatment
Examples: Equal treatment at the counter is cheaper than any policy. | They demanded equal treatment and were offered a leaflet.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + charity shop + raises
Examples: Nine charity shops trade on that high street. | The charity shop funds the whole advice service.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; run/a + soup kitchen
Examples: The soup kitchen opens four nights a week. | A soup kitchen in a wealthy district says something.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; open/a + warm bank
Examples: Libraries opened as warm banks that winter. | A warm bank is a library with the heating left on.

Pattern: give/need + a helping hand
Examples: A helping hand at the right week prevents a year of debt. | They gave her a helping hand and no advice.

Pattern: pull together
Examples: The street pulled together after the flooding. | They pulled together for a fortnight and then argued.

Pattern: give back + to + N
Examples: He gives back to the club that taught him. | Giving back here means turning up on Saturdays.

Pattern: go without + N
Examples: Parents go without so the children do not. | They went without heating for most of February.

Definition: lần hồi, bữa đói bữa no
Pattern: live + from hand to mouth
Examples: They lived from hand to mouth for nine months. | Living from hand to mouth makes planning impossible.

Pattern: be/live + on the breadline
Examples: A fifth of the ward lives on the breadline. | They were on the breadline and both in work.

Pattern: make ends meet
Examples: Two jobs were needed to make ends meet. | She makes ends meet by doing without.

Pattern: be/provide + a lifeline
Examples: The bus is a lifeline for nine villages. | The weekly visit was a lifeline nobody funded.

Pattern: afford + the bare necessities
Examples: They can afford the bare necessities and nothing unexpected. | The grant covers the bare necessities only.

Pattern: know one's rights
Examples: Tenants who know their rights are treated differently. | She knew her rights and brought the letter with her.
